name: settle to a stored pattern by energy descent
mechanism: store patterns as symmetric connection weights, then from a corrupted input repeatedly update units toward the sign of their weighted input so an energy decreases until the state stops changing at a stored pattern

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Hopfield net' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: a Recurrent neural network in which all connections are symmetric

fails_when: spurious attractors; capacity a small fraction of the unit count
